column1: # Columns, tab-separated: expect (block | allow), the branch the scratch
# repository is on (main | feature), and the Bash command as Claude Code
# passes it. <NL> in a command becomes a newline.
# --- blocked since the hook was added
# --- command word behind assignments, paths, quotes, keywords, wrappers

column3: sudo -u root git push -f origin x
env -u FOO GIT_X=1 nohup git push -f origin x
if git push -f origin x; then echo ok; fi
echo x | xargs git push -f origin
git switch main; git push origin
git checkout - && git push origin HEAD
GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=core.hooksPath GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=/dev/null git commit -m x

column1: # --- review: quoted or escaped ">", "<", "\" and "#" must not hide a word
# --- review: abbreviations, aliases, config entries, option values, comments, wrappers, other commands and push targets

column3: exec -a foo git push -f origin x
sudo -E env GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git push -f origin x
sudo -u git git push -f origin x
git switch -c fix/x origin/main && git push -u origin fix/x
git checkout main && git pull && git switch -c fix/y && git push -u origin HEAD
git checkout -b fix/y main && git push -u origin HEAD
git checkout main -- go.mod && git push origin HEAD
gh pr create --title "Close bypasses" --body "Summary<NL><NL>- blocks git push -f behind env"
gh pr create --title "x" --body "Never run gh pr merge --admin"
git switch -c fix/z && git push -u origin fix/z

block	feature	git commit -m Reject -inf and -nan values"
git commit -m "Block git commit -nm in the guard"

column1: # --- second review: config keys, split trailers, wrappers, checkout values, gh aliases, send-pack

column3: git config remote.origin.mirror true && git push origin
git config alias.p "push -f" && git p origin x
git config push.default matching && git push
GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=alias.p GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0="push -f" git p origin x
runuser -u me -- git push -f origin x
ssh localhost git push -f origin x
git checkout -Bmain origin/main && git push origin HEAD
git checkout main && git pull && git push origin v0.5.0
git switch -c fix/a origin/main && git commit -m x && git push -u origin fix/a
gh pr merge 26 --merge --delete-branch && git checkout main && git pull

column1: # The old hook blocked these, but git or gh rejects them, or (-o HEAD)
# HEAD is a push option and only x is pushed.
# --- third review: substitutions, push.default upstream, config option values, mirror remotes, refspec sides

column3: git switch -c fix/x origin/main && git -c push.default=upstream push
git config push.default upstream && git push
git config --comment --list alias.p "push -f" && git p origin x
git config set --comment --list remote.origin.mirror true && git push origin
git config --comment -l push.default matching && git push
git remote add --mirror=push backup git@github.com:o/r.git && git push backup
git switch --force-create=main origin/main && git push origin HEAD

column1: # Every alias write is blocked, harmless ones included.

# branch-creating checkout clears an earlier checkout of main even when
# it fails before a ;-separated push. The real HEAD is always checked.

column2: git checkout main; git checkout -b fix/x; git push -u origin HEAD
